about_the_game:
• story

You wake up in a strange house and look for a way out to escape as quickly as possible. However, you cannot escape from the house because the doors are locked by numerous locks.

Still, you try to find a way out of the house and look for something you can use inside. Then, Banshee, a frightening looking fairy, attacked you.

Can you escape from the house of horror by using the items you picked up along the way, while running away from Banshee?

  • About the game

This is an exploration type horror game.

The objective of the game is to find items while exploring the dimly lit house, and sometimes combine items to escape.

Banshee, a frightening looking fairy, will chase you while you are exploring. If you are caught, you will be beaten and forced to return to your initial location.

If you are caught by “Banshee,” one day will pass, and if you exceed the fifth day, you will be Game Over, so try not to get caught.

There are also traps and surprises along the way to lure “Banshee.

content_descriptors.notes: The game "BANSHEE" contains scary sound and mild violence.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 470 with 4GB VRAM ／ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
